thread:
Asha (sales): Quick sync — Mara at Spectra wants a POC + pricing path. Core asks: SSO (SAML 2.0, IdP-initiated), SCIM delta sync for groups, RBAC mapping to our roles, and strict domain-based tenant lock. POC Wed next week. Can we outline runbook + quote path and call out blockers? @Miguel @Priya @Jon @Mara
Miguel (solutions): SGTM. My rough estimate: 2 dev-days for SCIM adapter + 1.5 for RBAC mapping + 1 day for SAML test harness. If we include dedicated logging & tracing for audit, add 0.5 days. Will draft runbook.
Priya (security): Need to confirm SCIM auth mode (Bearer token) and rotation cadence. Also KMS integration for any user attributes we persist? We should require JWE for sensitive attrs.
Jon (legal): Also flagging contract ask: they want data residency in EU for user attrs. Need to confirm if Private or Dedicated required. Pricing changes if Dedicated.
Mara (Spectra IT): For the POC we can provide a test IdP (Okta) and a small user set. We need sample mapping: Okta groups -> product roles. Also need domain verification flow for onboarding.
Miguel (solutions): Draft runbook outline — will post below. Quick note on SCIM endpoints we plan to expose for delta sync:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users?filter=meta.lastModified gt 2024-03-01
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Also will include backoff guidance for bulk changes.
Priya (security): For token rotation propose 30d TTL + immediate revocation webhook. Can we add HMAC signature on deltas?
Miguel (solutions): HMAC header ok, we can add X-SCIM-Signature: sha256=... — small dev effort.
Jon (legal): If they want EU residency we need to route POC to our eu-1 region; that triggers Dedicated pricing floor. I'll attach clause language later.
deploy-bot: Reminder — runbook template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/identity-integration (editable) :link:
Asha (sales): Great. Can everyone add blockers and an estimated ETA into the runbook by EOD tomorrow? I need a line-item quote for # of dev-days + any Dedicated delta for pricing.
Mara (Spectra IT): One more question — how does domain-based tenant lock work for invitations? We want enforcement at account creation + periodic recheck.
Miguel (solutions): Implementation note: verify MX/TXT on onboarding and store domain fingerprint; recheck via cron job weekly. If mismatch, disable new token issuance.
Priya (security): Also require org admin 2FA before doing domain verification operations.
Asha (sales): Perfect. I'll prepare the proposal matrix (POC vs Prod) once runbook inputs are in. Next sync Friday 10am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
